payload.title: lift_sandbox_pin builds its own 'git diff --name-status -z --no-renames' argv and its own zip-based parser, although change_paths.py declares itself the one reader of that argv and parse (which refuses an unknown status and an odd field count); the owner should gain a working-tree mode instead of a second copy existing
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:610-611 (the lift's own zip-based parse of the listing)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_paths.py:1-15 (the module states it is the one reader of the argv and its parse)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_paths.py:65-70 (name_status_args takes two revisions, not a revision and a checkout)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/change_paths.py:73-91 (parse_name_status_z refuses an unknown status and an odd field count)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per concept (ARIA-CRITICAL-214): the argv that reads a change's path set and the parse of its output live in change_paths.py, and every consumer reads through it
payload.notes: Registered by the D6 findings clerk from the D6 review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head ac106b734 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: change_paths gains a working-tree mode (a name-status read of one revision against a checkout, with the untracked adds listed through the same module), lift_sandbox_pin reads through it, and the argv and the parse exist once. Test: a malformed listing makes lift_sandbox_pin raise change_paths_output_malformed, not return a short pin.
